# Gasherbrum II climbing guide

*Updated March 2024*

Gasherbrum II (8,035 m) is often called the easiest 8,000 m peak in the Karakoram.

## Permits

| Season | Royalty per foreign climber |
| --- | --- |
| Summer | USD 4,000 |
| Autumn | USD 2,000 |

The royalty is paid to the tourism department before the expedition.

# Royalty schedule 2026: peaks above 8,000 m

Issued 15 January 2026. Applies to expeditions from 1 March 2026.

| Peak | Height | Summer, per foreign climber | Winter, per foreign climber |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| K2 | 8,611 m | USD 5,000 | USD 1,500 |
| Gasherbrum II | 8,035 m | USD 4,600 | USD 1,200 |
| Broad Peak | 8,051 m | USD 4,600 | USD 1,200 |
